design: Frozen H755 scalar/block8 fits, all three seeds, versus H754 fixed/adaptive writePCA8 and three randomTopK8 controls. L5H3/H5. On every H747 context add reconstructed head difference F(donor)-F(receiver) at both selected positions, leaving native baseline. Compare full raw difference. Evaluate free downstream Q2/K2, full native clamp, and original-operation rank4 spherical clamp. No fitting on tasks. Measure total intended-margin effects and full/compact-node dependence relative to full head swap.
limitations: Reused task panel, not fresh confirmation. Both positions jointly edited. Small dependence contrasts can amplify relative errors; report absolute RMS references. Training finite and block baseline not Grassmannian BSF. Natural reconstruction, task effect and component dependence are distinct.
